title: Sweet and Sour Meatballs

items.prep: use a tomato sauce can to measure

instructions: In a large pot set over medium-high heat, add the oil, onion, 1 tablespoon of the salt, and 1 teaspoon of the pepper. Cook for about 8 minutes, stirring often, until the onions are translucent.
Add the remaining sauce ingredients; stir to combine. Remove from heat.
To a large bowl, add all the meatball ingredients. Use your hands to gently mix the meat to incorporate the ingredients — be gentle and do not overwork the mixture, so the meatballs stay tender.
Return the sweet and sour sauce to a boil. Carefully add the meatballs, one at a time. Return to a boil again, then reduce the heat to low and cover the pot.
Simmer the meatballs for 1 hour, gently stirring every 15 minutes.

tips.title: Freezer tip
tips.text: These freeze really, really well. Double the recipe and make portions to fit your needs. Refrigerate until completely cool, then place a layer of plastic wrap directly onto the meatballs and cover the freezer container with an airtight lid. Write the date on the container; use within 2 months.

tips.title: Unstuffed cabbage variation
tips.text: Add 3 cups shredded white cabbage to the sauce and use 1 cup raw rice instead of breadcrumbs in the meat mixture for a quick and easy version of unstuffed cabbage.
